items.item:
2. A service answer with a timestamp far in the future changes no kernel record's
   time or order.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a19_service_timestamp_not_kernel_time]
statements:
```text
kernel_timestamp -> clock_module.now
request_field(current_time) -> refused
service_timestamp -/> kernel_timestamp
stored(monotonic_reading) -> never
```

assert [e.run_id for e in trace] == [run_b.run_id, run_a.run_id]
verdicts.why: The selected test asserts that run and node-execution timestamps equal the injected kernel clock and that record order remains store order despite opposing service and kernel times. It does not assert that request-supplied current-time fields are refused or that monotonic readings are never stored; those are covered only by unselected tests.
